subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ-V6 across its S-Type X200 application.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ-V6 appears primarily in the S-Type, with the 3.0-litre capacity being the more common of the two we encounter.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported catastrophic issue pattern has been confirmed for the AJ-V6 legacy petrol engines. We don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode; diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ-V6 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ-V6 REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJ-V6's timing chain system is accessed as part of a full strip-down. A full rebuild also includes inspection of the oil pump and cooling system components, as these are key areas we check during every AJ-V6 rebuild.

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
